name: Fire
description: Warm, bright, and bad at staying put. Every kitchen keeps some, and every kitchen has a story about it.

name: Water
description: Goes wherever it likes and tidies as it goes. Half of all recipes start here.

name: Earth
description: Patient stuff. It holds up the house and asks only that you wipe your boots.

name: Air
description: Carries smells, songs, and gossip at no charge. Hard to keep in a jar.

name: Light
description: Shows you where you left things. Flattering in the morning, honest by noon.

name: Life
description: The part that grows, wriggles, and wants breakfast. Given time, it gets into everything.

name: Shadow
description: Light's quieter cousin. Good for naps, surprises, and keeping the butter cool.

name: Death
description: The tidy end of things. Polite, punctual, and very good for the compost.

name: Mud
description: Water and Earth, holding hands. They will not let go.

name: Steam
description: Water in a hurry. It whistles when it wants attention.

name: Metal
description: Stone that agreed to be useful after a long talk with the fire. Rings nicely when tapped.

name: Tree
description: Tall, leafy, and in no rush at all. Provides shade, apples, and somewhere to think.

name: Smoke
description: What the fire sends up when it has finished with the wood. Smells of autumn.

name: Mind
description: A creature that has started having opinions. Mostly about dinner.

name: Sand
description: Stone, after a very long holiday at the beach. Turns up in your shoes weeks later.

name: Sound
description: Air with something to say. Travels well over water.

name: Salt
description: What the kettle leaves behind when the sea boils off. Makes everything taste more like itself.

name: Glass
description: Sand that went through the fire and came out see-through. It would like to be dusted.

name: Iron
description: Grey, dependable, and happiest when warm. Rusts a little if it feels ignored.

name: Silver
description: Metal with good manners. Takes a polish and shows you your own nose.

name: Animal
description: Something furry with opinions. It has already decided how it feels about you.

name: Blood
description: Life's own delivery service. Best left where it is, running its rounds.

name: Spirits
description: Clear, sharp, and strong enough to clean a kettle. Sold as medicine, bought as optimism.

name: Sulfur
description: Yellow powder that smells of struck matches and old eggs. Store it downwind.

name: Crystal
description: Glass that caught some light and decided to keep it. Hums a little on sunny days.

name: Gold
description: Soft, heavy, and very pleased with itself. Somehow never where you left it.

name: Bat
description: A small leather umbrella with ears. Finds its way home by shouting politely.

name: Food
description: Bread, mostly, with ambitions toward soup. Smells like someone is home.

name: Feather
description: Light, tidy, and shed without complaint. Still remembers how to float.

name: Rotted leaves
description: Last autumn, thoroughly relaxed. The garden thinks it is delicious.

name: Bone dust
description: Fine, pale powder, very good for the roses. The label says only "garden supplies."

name: Bat guano
description: Rich, mysterious, and sold by the bucket. Nobody asks where from.

name: Person
description: Mud that stood up, stretched, and asked what was for breakfast.

name: Forge
description: A fire with a job and strong opinions about iron. Smells of warm metal and yesterday's coal.

name: Herb
description: Small, green, and smug about how useful it is. Smells wonderful when you step on it by accident.

name: Wilds
description: Where the trees and the animals have things arranged to their liking. Visitors are tolerated if they bring snacks.

name: Crown
description: Gold and crystal, arranged to sit on a head. Heavier than it looks, and no use in the rain.

name: Tea
description: Leaves and hot water, taking their time. Fixes most things a little.

name: Spellbook
description: A book that listens. The pages hold a spell still while you get it right.
